Squaring the inequality gives
\[
(x^2-4x-39601)^2-(x^2+4x-39601)^2\ge 0.
\]
Factoring,
\[
(x^2-4x-39601)^2-(x^2+4x-39601)^2
=(A-B)(A+B)
=(-8x)(2x^2-79202)
=-16x(x^2-39601).
\]
Thus
\[
-16x(x-199)(x+199)\ge 0,
\]
or equivalently
\[
x(x-199)(x+199)\le 0.
\]
The solution is
\[
x\in(-\infty,-199]\cup[0,199].
\]
So the largest value is
\[
\boxed{199}.
\]
